candidates.expected_benefit: Improves ambiguous queued references while preserving foreground obligations.
candidates.foreground_chat_interaction: foreground factual questions bypass goal-thread reconciliation
candidates.hypothesis: A topic-boundary-aware queued reconciliation pass can resolve or clarify references before background cognition consumes them.
candidates.latency: low deterministic pass plus optional Qwen ranking
candidates.mechanism: Build a discourse candidate map from foreground turns, queued goal-thread turns, corrections, and tentative goals; rank referents by lane, recency, and ambiguity; clarify when multiple candidates remain.
candidates.restart_behavior: candidate map is reconstructible from persisted turns
candidates.rollback: remove reconciliation pass and fall back to preserved queued text
candidates.tentative_goal_interaction: tentative goals may be mentioned but never activated

acceptance_criteria: must not degrade negative and unrelated controls
candidates.hypothesis: A last-mentioned-object heuristic will cheaply resolve most references.
candidates.mechanism: Always bind it/that/one to the latest salient noun phrase regardless of lane.
candidates.tentative_goal_interaction: risk of activating future goal references

failure_modes: generic clarification for specific held-out referents
candidates.hypothesis: A correction-conditioned applicability filter can prevent false transfer while allowing goal-thread clarifications.
candidates.mechanism: Classify whether a turn is goal-thread related before applying correction-derived reference lessons.
candidates.rollback: disable applicability gate for queued reconciliation
